context: Make external-link checking resilient rather than removing it. Options, roughly in order of preference: raise linkcheck_retries and linkcheck_timeout in the Sphinx config; add a linkcheck_ignore / linkcheck_allowed_redirects entry for domains that are chronically slow but known-good; or split external link checking into its own scheduled (non-PR) job so PR feedback stays deterministic while genuine rot is still caught daily. Verify by asserting the config actually carries retries plus either an ignore policy or a scheduled split - not merely that the file mentions linkcheck.
description: The linkcheck job in the docs build fails the whole job when any external URL times out. Observed on PR #1510 (run 30905957137): 'broken https://www.hammerdb.com/ - HTTPSConnectionPool read timed out (read timeout=60)' from concepts/benchmarking-tools-compared.md line 212, a file that PR did not touch. Sphinx reported 'build finished with problems, 1 warning' and exited 1. The run also shows GitHub rate-limiting (-rate limited- ... sleeping) on github.com URLs, which adds minutes and makes the job flakier the more GitHub links the docs accumulate. Net effect: an unrelated PR gets a red job for a third-party site being slow, which trains reviewers to ignore linkcheck - the failure mode that hides a real broken link. ci-required-result passed independently, so this does not block merges today; it is noise that erodes signal.

preserves.behavior: Internal (relative) link breakage still fails CI - only external-host flakiness is softened

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import pathlib, re; s = pathlib.Path('docs/conf.py').read_text(); assert re.search(r'linkcheck_retries\s*=\s*[2-9]', s), 'linkcheck_retries is unset or 1'; assert 'linkcheck_ignore' in s or 'linkcheck_timeout' in s, 'no ignore/timeout policy'"
verifications.description: Sphinx linkcheck is configured to retry rather than fail on first timeout
verifications.expected: exits 1 on the unfixed tree where conf.py sets no retry policy; exits 0 once retries plus a timeout or ignore policy are configured

work_units.evidence: Implemented in PR #1051 (commit 5b69a1dfe7187db4ca53bbd080023fd69cac2465). docs/conf.py:168-195 configures linkcheck_timeout=60, linkcheck_retries=2, linkcheck_report_timeouts_as_broken=True, curated linkcheck_ignore via docs/linkcheck_ignore.txt, and linkcheck_anchors_ignore_for_url for docs.snowflake.com. Acceptance verified via docs linkcheck verification regex and clean documentation CI run 34035817970 on develop.
work_units.summary: Verify linkcheck retry and timeout resilience controls in docs/conf.py against PR #1051
